prs.title: handover: follow-up 52 — cut #527, and correct the deployment, calibration, restore-drill, operator, member and backup guides against the code
backup: isolated restores start from configuration they write themselves, keep only the restore's recovery settings and clean up after a failure; script guards no longer depend on the locale
worker: run the node staleness sweep as a scheduled job, so a node that stops reporting becomes stale and then offline instead of staying online
portal: the admin node summary and overview state only what each node's fields show, so stale, offline, enrolling and expired nodes are not called online or serving
nodes: complete a member or device operation's nodes step only when every exit it affects has applied the change or is recorded as unconfirmed
